title: 消化氣淨化與利用
summary: 本課以沼氣污染物分離、甲烷回收與淨能源為主線，從乾基氣量與甲烷分率、水分與冷凝、硫化氫吸附床、矽氧烷與設備沉積進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops biogas contaminant separation, methane recovery and net energy through ten connected units, beginning with dry-gas volume and methane fraction, moisture and condensation, hydrogen-sulfide sorbent bed, siloxanes and equipment deposition. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 乾基氣量與甲烷分率：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Dry-gas volume and methane fraction: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 乾基氣量與甲烷分率 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Dry-gas volume and methane fraction and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 先統一乾濕基、溫度與壓力，再把總沼氣換成甲烷量。
steps.instructionEn: Normalize moisture, temperature and pressure before converting biogas to methane volume.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：乾沼氣=500 m³/d；CH4 體積分率=0.60。模型 VCH4=Vgas xCH4，代入得到 300 m³ CH4/d。適用邊界：同一乾基與溫壓；CO2 去除會改變分率而不必然增加甲烷量。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Dry biogas=500 m³/d; CH4 volume fraction=0.60. Model VCH4=Vgas xCH4 gives 300 m³ CH4/d. Applicability: Common dry basis and temperature/pressure; CO2 removal can raise the fraction without increasing methane quantity.
steps.failure: 不同標準狀態的流量被直接相加。診斷與介入：以溫壓一致的甲烷組成分析重算，確認乾濕基準。
steps.failureEn: Flows at different reference states are added directly. Diagnostic response: Recalculate from same-condition methane analysis and verify wet/dry basis.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「乾基氣量與甲烷分率」的觀測點。使用氣體分析器與標準化流量計配對。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for dry-gas volume and methane fraction. Pair gas composition with normalized volumetric flow. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只改變 xCH4:0.60→0.55，其餘假設固定；結果應由 300 變為 275 m³ CH4/d。用「乾基氣量與甲烷分率」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。
knowledge.textEn: Change only xCH4:0.60→0.55, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 300 to 275 m³ CH4/d. Explain the direction using dry-gas volume and methane fraction, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

steps.title: 水分與冷凝：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Moisture and condensation: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 水分與冷凝 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Moisture and condensation and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 冷凝降低含濕量，但露點必須以出口壓力及溫度驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Condensation lowers moisture, but validate dew point at outlet pressure/temperature.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：入口水蒸氣負荷=20 kg/d；冷凝去除=15 kg/d。模型 Mremain=Min-Mcond，代入得到 5 kg water/d。適用邊界：水分收支不等於露點合格；還須氣壓、氣溫及含濕量。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Inlet water-vapor load=20 kg/d; condensed removal=15 kg/d. Model Mremain=Min-Mcond gives 5 kg water/d. Applicability: A water balance does not prove dew-point compliance; gas pressure, temperature and humidity are needed.
steps.failure: 排出冷凝水就宣稱完全乾燥。診斷與介入：另測露點與含濕，檢查排水及下游相容性。
steps.failureEn: Collected condensate does not prove complete drying. Diagnostic response: Measure dew point/moisture separately and check drainage/downstream compatibility.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「水分與冷凝」的觀測點。量冷凝水並以露點儀確認乾燥器出口。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for moisture and condensation. Measure condensate and check dryer outlet with a dew-point instrument. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
